items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Paul Chambers would be coming to my apartment. “I got a date here is the music can we work on it over here?” ... So, we had a gathering of musicians like that.

ctx.x: You know, when you hear with Golson, was Buck somebody you had to go through? At some point, Adams was here, you know, Stitt was here, it was different people…
Well, Sonny married a girl from here, Barbara. He is from Detroit. He wasn't born in Detroit, he was actually born, like Paul Chambers, in Pittsburgh. I think Sonny Stitt was too.
Next to it or something, someplace near Detroit.
